title: YourMondayMotivator - Where are you at today?
html:
It's a rainy old morning at the beach today. We got up early, went for a walk before the rain came and had a great cook up for breakfast.

Then we just sat here and were having a quiet morning when I realised I hadn't written the MondayMotivator.

A lot of people have gone home and it occurred to me that maybe I had finally relaxed after a week of being on 'holiday'. My thoughts are a bit clearer, my breathing slower and I am wondering where I am at.

Pablo Picasso said, "When I work I relax; doing nothing or entertaining visitors makes me tired."

Where are you at today? Are you finally relaxed after all the entertaining or doing nothing and ready for the year ahead.

I'm really looking forward to twenty ten and I hope you are too.
